{{Quote|A cool wind blows from inside this cave. An ancient city is said to sleep in its depths.|Description}}
'''Nargai Cave''' {{J|ナルガエ洞穴|Narugae dōketsu}} is a cave location in ''[[Final Fantasy Tactics Advance]]''.

It is the site of "Mission 011: Pale Company". Rumors of ghosts in the cave lead [[Marche Radiuju|Marche]] to investigate. He then finds a seam and is teleported to the third shrine, where [[Adrammelech (Tactics Advance)|Adrammelech]], the [[Totema]] of the [[bangaa]], resides. Marche defeats the Totema and the third [[Crystal (term)|Crystal]] shatters. Nargai Cave is also the site of "Mission #058: Royal Ruins", "Mission #078: Water Sigil", and is the spawn location of "Mission #110: Revenge". It can be freed in "Mission #249: Nargai Cave" after "Mission #013: The Bounty".
